items.title_en: NDRC Spokesperson Answers Questions on the Guiding Opinions on Improving the Price Formation Mechanism to Promote Quality and Expansion of Inclusive Elderly Care Services
items.title_original: 国家发展改革委新闻发言人就《关于进一步完善价格形成机制 推动普惠养老服务提质扩面的指导意见》答记者问
items.source: 国家发展和改革委员会
items.what_happened: 国家发展改革委、民政部、国家卫生健康委三部门联合印发《关于进一步完善价格形成机制 推动普惠养老服务提质扩面的指导意见》（发改价格〔2026〕1476号）。意见对公办养老机构基本服务收费实行政府指导价管理，对民办普惠性养老机构基本服务收费实行政府指导价管理或设置参考区间，并区分兜底保障型、普惠支持型、完全市场型等不同机构类型，基本服务、非基本服务、上门服务等不同服务类型实行差异化收费管理。
items.what_happened_en: The National Development and Reform Commission, the Ministry of Civil Affairs, and the National Health Commission jointly issued the Guiding Opinions on Further Improving the Price Formation Mechanism to Promote the Quality and Expansion of Inclusive Elderly Care Services (NDRC Price [2026] No. 1476). The Opinions apply government-guided pricing to basic service fees at public elderly care institutions, and government-guided pricing or reference ranges to basic service fees at private inclusive elderly care institutions, with differentiated management by institution type (safety-net, inclusive-support, fully market-based) and service type (basic, non-basic, home-visit).
items.why_it_matters: 该政策旨在推动价格可负担、质量有保障、运营可持续的普惠养老服务，引导供给结构优化调整，更好满足人口老龄化背景下人民群众多元化养老服务需求。
items.why_it_matters_en: The measure aims to make elderly care more affordable and accessible while ensuring sustainable operations, guiding supply structure optimization to meet diverse needs amid rapid population aging.

items.title_cn: 新型芯片级“光尺”有望革新移动计时并增强国家安全
items.title_en: New Chip-Based 'Tape Measure' for Light Could Revolutionize Mobile Timekeeping and Enhance National Security
items.title_original: New Chip-Based ‘Tape Measure’ for Light Could Revolutionize Mobile Timekeeping and Enhance National Security
items.what_happened: 美国国家标准与技术研究院（NIST）及其合作者展示了一种生成微型光尺（微梳）的新方法。微梳在晶圆上制造，每个晶圆包含超过400个芯片，每个芯片容纳多达300个微型环形谐振器，构成该技术的核心。
items.what_happened_en: Researchers at the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) and their colleagues demonstrated a new way to generate a miniature tape measure for light, called a microcomb. The microcombs are fabricated on wafers, with each wafer containing more than 400 chips, and each chip housing up to 300 tiny ring-shaped resonators that form the heart of the technology.
items.why_it_matters: 该技术有望革新移动计时并增强国家安全。
items.why_it_matters_en: The technology could revolutionize mobile timekeeping and enhance national security.

items.title_cn: 国家发展改革委等三部门完善养老服务价格政策
items.title_en: NDRC and Two Other Departments Improve Pricing Policy for Elderly Care Services
items.title_original: 国家发展改革委等三部门完善养老服务价格政策
items.source: 国家发展和改革委员会
items.what_happened: 国家发展改革委、民政部、国家卫生健康委联合印发《关于进一步完善价格形成机制 推动普惠养老服务提质扩面的指导意见》。指导意见将养老机构分为兜底保障型、普惠支持型和完全市场型，分类完善价格管理方式。评估周期原则上不超过3年。发布时间：2026/10/16。
items.what_happened_en: NDRC, Ministry of Civil Affairs, and National Health Commission jointly issued guidance on improving the price formation mechanism to promote affordable elderly care services. The guidance categorizes institutions into basic, affordable, and market-based types, with different pricing mechanisms. Evaluation cycle in principle not exceeding 3 years. Publication date: 2026-10-16.
items.why_it_matters: 政策旨在扩大普惠养老服务供给，促进养老服务事业和产业协同发展，影响服务机构和消费者。
items.why_it_matters_en: The policy aims to expand affordable elderly care supply and promote coordinated development of the elderly care industry, affecting service providers and consumers.
